description: On the bed in front of you, there’s a white pedestal-like piece with a round top and a separate white cup-shaped piece beside it. The left hand moves in toward the pedestal base to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches from the right to grasp the cup-shaped piece as a right-hand object, lifts it up, then lowers and fits it down over the round top before releasing, leaving it assembled on the pedestal.
